title: The VSMC RNA-seq datasets for Strategies for Arterial Grafts Optimization
author: Chang, Yuan
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0
materials: This dataset collection contains the human vascular smooth muscle cell (VSMC) bulk RNA-seq data generated in the study Strategies for Arterial Grafts Optimization at Single Cell Level . Primary human VSMCs (CP-H167, Pricella) were cultured in DM/F12 medium supplemented with FBS, EGF, bFGF, insulin, and penicillin (CM-P167, Pricella). The media was replaced per 48 hours. VSMCs were treated with 100ng/ml MIF (HY-P7387, MCE) for 24 hours in the absence or presence of 50 µMol ISO1 (HY-16692, MCE). The VSMCs with the passage number 3 to 5 were used in the study. Total RNA was extracted from cultured VSMC under different treatments using RNeasy Mini Kit (74104, Qiagen). A total amount of 1 µg RNA per sample was used as input material for the RNA sample preparations. Sequencing libraries were generated using NEBNext® UltraTM RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina® (NEB, USA) following manufacturer’s recommendations and index codes were added to attribute sequences to each sample. The library preparations were sequenced on an Illumina Novaseq platform and 150 bp paired-end reads were generated. The index of the reference genome was built using Hisat2 v2.0.

steps.title: Culture VSMCs in supplemented DM/F12
steps.instruction: Maintain primary human VSMCs (CP‑H167, Pricella) in DM/F12 medium supplemented with fetal bovine serum, epidermal growth factor, basic fibroblast growth factor, insulin, and penicillin (commercial medium CM‑P167, Pricella); replace the medium every 48 hours and use cells at passage numbers 3 to 5.

steps.title: Treat VSMCs with MIF ± ISO1
steps.instruction: Add 100 ng ml⁻¹ MIF (HY‑P7387, MCE) to the cultures for 24 hours; for the combination condition also add 50 µM ISO1 (HY‑16692, MCE) simultaneously.

substeps.instruction: Add 100 ng ml⁻¹ MIF alone and incubate 24 h.
Add 100 ng ml⁻¹ MIF together with 50 µM ISO1 and incubate 24 h.

steps.title: Extract total RNA with RNeasy kit
steps.instruction: Harvest the cells and isolate total RNA using the RNeasy Mini Kit (Qiagen, catalog 74104) following the manufacturer’s protocol.

steps.title: Prepare RNA‑seq libraries using NEBNext Ultra
steps.instruction: Use 1 µg of extracted RNA per sample as input; generate sequencing libraries with the NEBNext® Ultra™ RNA Library Prep Kit for Illumina® (NEB, USA) according to the kit’s recommendations and add unique index codes to each library.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on Illumina NovaSeq
steps.instruction: Pool the indexed libraries and sequence them on an Illumina NovaSeq platform to obtain 150 bp paired‑end reads.

steps.title: Build reference index and align reads with Hisat2
steps.instruction: Build the reference genome index using Hisat2 version 2.0.5, then align the paired‑end clean reads to the reference genome with Hisat2 v2.0.5 to produce BAM files.
